subtitle: Daily tefillin and community
description:
Build your daily tefillin practice with Ratzon. Record your check-ins, follow your streaks, review your personal history, and participate in your community.

Ratzon Membership provides ongoing access to these digital app features through an auto-renewable subscription. Your participation and check-in completion do not affect paid access. The app displays the current localized App Store price and subscription period before purchase.

Each month, eligible subscribers may vote among a rotating selection of charities. Separately, Ratzon commits to donating 100% of its positive monthly net subscription profits after Apple commissions, refunds, applicable taxes, and documented operating costs. Subscription payments are for digital services and do not create a personal donation balance. There is no guaranteed donation amount per subscription. Company donations and confirmed results are recorded in the app.

Payment is charged to your Apple account at purchase confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple account settings. You can restore an existing subscription in the app.

Privacy Policy: https://ratzonapp.com/privacy.html
Service Terms: https://ratzonapp.com/terms.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

subscription_price: Set the actual supported price tier in App Store Connect; do not paste a hardcoded $2.16 if unavailable.
review_notes: Ratzon Membership purchases ongoing digital access to check-ins, streak tracking, personal history and community features through StoreKit. Users have no monetary wallet, earnings, withdrawal rights or individual donation balance. Check-in completion does not affect access. Separately, Ratzon donates its own positive monthly net subscription profits after reconciliation; members may cast one vote for the recipient of that company donation from a rotating slate. No personal donations are collected or allocated. All physical tefillin purchasing and tefillin goal balances were removed. Members who do not own tefillin are directed to their nearest campus or local Chabad center. The purchase screen shows the actual localized StoreKit price and period, auto-renewal disclosures, restore purchases, and legal links. The existing product identifier is preserved for subscriber continuity, while its display name is Ratzon Membership. Sign in with Apple saves supplied names and does not require a repeat full-name field. Include reviewer credentials separately using the App Store Connect credential fields.
